name: Book Metadata Provider (Open Library / Google Books)
description: Official book metadata provider. Subscribes to metadata.provider.query and answers only lookups with itemType=book: Open Library (keyless) by ISBN or title/author, Google Books as fallback/enrichment (API key optional). Returns title, overview, year, authors (writer), ISBN/Open Library/Google Books ids and cover URL.

permissions.reason: Receive book lookups (title, authors, ISBN, year, language) and contribute whitelist metadata fields via the sync response.

configSchema.label: Google Books API key
configSchema.helpText: Optional. Without a key Google Books is still queried anonymously (lower quota).
